method: Complete OSM ways with native tags; independent display-path clipping to query bounds. Editor account metadata excluded.
policy: Community road mapping, not a survey or confirmation of public access, campus access, ownership or present condition. Native access tags remain independent source statements. Edit times are not image dates. Coverage is partial; absence is not proof of absence.
